title: Quick-Fix Tender Uruguayan Pork Belly Burger
description: A quick and flavorful Uruguayan-style burger featuring pork belly slices, bhuna, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the pork belly slices in a skillet over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a separate skillet, add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sauté the red onion and garlic until softened.
Add the bhuna sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Split the macrobiotic-friendly buns in half and toast them in the oven for 2-3 minutes.

Assemble the burgers by placing a few slices of the cooked pork belly on the bottom bun, followed by a spoonful of the bhuna sauce mixture, a few slices of the Uruguayan-style sausage, and finally the top bun.
Drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Reheat the bhuna sauce in the microwave for 10-15 seconds if needed before serving.
Store any leftover burgers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
